current_answer: OpenAI publishes a partner-VC referral path to possible API credits, not a universal credit amount. Ask the VC for its code, then verify the offer amount, expiry and covered API usage in the credited organisation. OpenAI says standard billing begins when credits run out. Self-funded founders should not assume this published route grants them API credit.

catalogue_card.question: Can a startup claim OpenAI API credits directly?
catalogue_card.text: OpenAI’s published startup-credit path runs through a partner VC and a unique referral code. The public FAQ gives no universal amount or expiry; standard billing begins when credits run out. Check the actual offer before spending.

summary: Partner-VC portfolio companies may be eligible for OpenAI API credits; the application needs a unique VC code and company/API-use details.
The public FAQ does not state a universal amount, expiry, cutoff, geography or covered-usage schedule.
NLnet still lists 3 November for Restack and CodeSupply; Interledger Local Impact remains paused. Other rows retain their dates.
uncertainty: Partner-specific allocation, duration, geography, covered API usage and approval require the actual offer or account.
No first-party visitor analytics or applicant outcome are available.
